observed_in: Magic and Spellcasting System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the likelihood and consequences of spells failing when cast, varying from guaranteed success to complete failure conditions that can result in negative effects. It affects player strategy and resource management by introducing risk into spellcasting.
exclusion_criteria: All spells succeed without any chance of failure
Failure has no impact on gameplay or player resources
inclusion_criteria: Spells can fail due to low skill level or insufficient resources
Failure can result in backlash or unintended effects
title: Spell Failure Mechanisms
